name: sang-monorepo
description: Monorepo: Sang app marketing site (www.sangapp.in) + Sang Event CRM (events.sangapp.in), built and deployed as two separate Cloudflare Pages projects.

scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:crm
scripts.build:app: cd app-site && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:crm: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:app && npm run deploy:crm
scripts.deploy:app: cd app-site && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name cms-software --branch main
scripts.deploy:crm: cd web && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sang-event-crm --branch main
